keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 5 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 15 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

themes.name: Vision-language-action robot manipulation
themes.summary: These papers study robot manipulation policies and world/action models that combine vision, language or demonstrations with control. They vary from spatial world-action pretraining and force-vision control to humanoid cooperative manipulation, VR-collected demonstrations, diffusion-policy fine-tuning, and bandwidth-aware policy uplinks.

themes.name: Efficient long-context and KV cache
themes.summary: This theme covers methods for making long-context LLM inference cheaper through KV-cache management, sparse attention, and cross-model or speculative decoding. Papers compress or share KV states, route sparse computation, and transfer prompt representations between models.

themes.name: Diffusion and flow matching generative models
themes.summary: These papers develop diffusion and flow-matching generators, often improving controllability or quality-coverage tradeoffs. They span competitive and data-conditioned flow matching, multimodal latent diffusion, motion-controlled video generation, unified image generation, and model merging.

themes.name: LLM agent safety and multi-agent reliability
themes.summary: This theme examines safety and reliability risks when LLM agents interact, delegate, or coordinate. Papers study backdoor poisoning in proactive dialogue, runtime authorization and multi-hop delegation, cross-agent formalization, reliability of multi-agent teams, and adolescent chatbot safety.

themes.name: RL post-training and verifier rewards
themes.summary: These papers focus on reinforcement-learning post-training and reward/verifier design for large models. They cover elastic expert parallelism, extrapolative on-policy distillation, preference-optimization constraint drift, safety alignment with verifiable rewards, spatial reasoning benchmarks, and safe RLHF exploration.

themes.name: Agent evaluation and benchmark auditing
themes.summary: This theme audits and improves evaluation of agents and LLM judges, including policy-based decision benchmarks and deployed-agent measurement. Papers examine proof-formalization preferences, benchmark errors, closed-loop evaluation, prompt maintenance for judges, soft-prompt adaptation, and multilingual tool-use evaluation.

themes.name: Medical imaging and clinical foundation models
themes.summary: These papers apply foundation models and imaging-specific architectures to clinical data such as skin lesions, pathology, mammography, EEG, and EHR records. They emphasize segmentation, calibrated uncertainty, agentic reading, pretraining adaptation, long time-context, and topology-aware transformers.

themes.name: 3D Gaussian splatting and reconstruction
themes.summary: This theme covers 3D scene reconstruction and rendering using Gaussian, mesh, and splatting representations. Papers address topology-aware splatting, hybrid mesh-Gaussian dissolve fields, view-graph selection, metric-depth streaming reconstruction, inverse rendering, and georeferenced cross-view geometry.

themes.name: Embodied navigation and robot world models
themes.summary: These papers study embodied navigation and robot world models for moving through and interacting with real environments. They include manipulation-based zero-shot navigation, LiDAR-inertial-visual odometry, object search with absence detection, grasp-navigation, multi-agent pathfinding, and instruction grounding under partial observability.

themes.name: Retrieval-augmented generation and routing
themes.summary: This theme develops retrieval-augmented generation and routing mechanisms for selecting, compressing, or grounding external evidence. Papers cover retrieval embeddings, selective retrieval for graph repair, latent-space document enrichment, evidence-constrained reasoning, embodied scene retrieval, and multi-agent enzyme retrieval.

themes.name: Time-series forecasting and anomaly detection
themes.summary: These papers address forecasting and anomaly detection in temporal data, including uncertainty calibration and changepoint localization. They evaluate frozen forecasters, learn realized volatility measures, detect machining anomalies acoustically, construct distribution-free changepoint intervals, model solar forecast uncertainty, and enforce rollout consistency.

themes.name: Agentic software engineering and coding agents
themes.summary: This theme studies agents that perform software engineering tasks over repositories and long projects. Papers examine risk-based CI testing and bug review, long-horizon multi-step coding, Rust verification benchmarks, code-representation choices, project takeover, and agent-native primitives for real-world tasks.

highlights.title: Multi-step SWE: Can Coding Agents Keep Building on Their Own Code Over Long Horizons?
highlights.authors: Xiangkai Zeng, Zheng Liu, Zihao Lin
highlights.theme: Agentic software engineering and coding agents
highlights.why: Long-horizon chained coding benchmark reveals frontier agents solve only 18.5% of tasks, highlighting a major limitation in self-referential code evolution.
highlights.key_result: We introduce Multi-step SWE , a long-horizon benchmark of 69 software engineering tasks, each a chain of 5--15 dependent steps on a single codebase. Across nine frontier models, the strongest model reaches a solve rate of only 18.5%, and 38 of the 69 tasks are not solved by any model.
evidence: We introduce Multi-step SWE , a long-horizon benchmark of 69 software engineering tasks, each a chain of 5--15 dependent steps on a single codebase. Every step is a complete, multi-hour engineering request that starts from the code the agent produced in the preceding steps, so early design decisions and errors carry forward. The tasks span four families of engineering work and nine languages, include both from-scratch builds and existing open-source codebases, and ground every step in an existing source of truth that defines both the instruction and its verifier. Across nine frontier models, the strongest model reaches a solve rate of only 18.5%, and 38 of the 69 tasks are not solved by any model.

highlights.title: Recursive Sparse Attention: Million-Token Length Extrapolation at Logarithmic Cost
highlights.authors: Ruitian Wang, Xinyu Yang, Minshen Zhang et al.
highlights.why: Claims million-token extrapolation at logarithmic cost, a potential breakthrough for long-context efficiency.
highlights.key_result: Initialized from Qwen3-4B and trained on 0.62B tokens at the original model's 32K training length, RecSA outperforms all baselines on RULER at every length from 131K to 2M; at 1M, it scores 60.5, compared with 40.0 for the best baseline, Dense + DCA. With our optimized kernels, RecSA is faster than dense attention in end-to-end prefill and decoding from 64K to 2M; at 524K on one H200 GPU, it accelerates prefill by 3.2 and decoding by 3.8 .

highlights.title: The Memory Trap: Language Agents Overgeneralize from Benign Interactions
highlights.authors: Kaiqu Liang, Jaime Fernandez Fisac, Thomas L. Griffiths et al.
highlights.theme: LLM agent safety and multi-agent reliability
highlights.why: Demonstrates persistent benign memory causes unsafe and unreliable behavior across six frontier models, exposing a critical agent failure mode.
highlights.key_result: We show that memory from benign interactions can cause unsafe or unreliable behavior on later tasks: from baselines below 0.01, notes raise the unsafe-action rate to 0.66 to 0.81 on Sonnet-4.6 and 0.35 to 0.58 on Opus-4.7, and notes formed this way raise Opus-4.8's cheating rate from 29% to 74% on ImpossibleBench.

From baselines below 0.01, notes raise the unsafe-action rate to 0.66 to 0.81 on Sonnet-4.6 and 0.35 to 0.58 on Opus-4.7.

On ImpossibleBench's SWE-bench conflicting split, whose tests conflict with the specification , stronger models can cheat more with memory: notes formed this way raise Opus-4.8's cheating rate from 29% to 74%, while Fable-5 is barely affected.

highlights.authors: Nischay Dhankhar, Alisher Amantay, Zhanibek Datbayev et al.
highlights.why: Open family of decision models that return distributions over options without autoregressive decoding, setting new SOTA on Decision Index and addressing production reliability.
highlights.key_result: On Decision Index 0.4.1, Max sets a new state-of-the-art among the decision models we compare (67.52 on the public suite vs 60.70 for Jev 1.14.0). Max answers a typical request in 183 ms, against about 2.0 s for GPT-6 Sol and 3.5 s for Claude Opus 5.5, and demonstrates output stability under option reordering.

highlights.title: EDGAR: Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement via Synthetic Failure
highlights.authors: Kwan Yun, Minhyeok Bang, Colette Suhjung Koo et al.
highlights.why: Diffusion-based refinement of Gaussian avatars via synthetic failures, with MoE and identity preservation, directly tackles common artifacts.
highlights.key_result: Experiments on three different Gaussian avatar reconstruction methods, each evaluated under three different settings, show improvements in both perceptual and reconstruction measures over the raw outputs and an SDEdit-style refinement baseline. In addition, cross-view evaluation demonstrates improved calibrated consistency, while tests under large yaw and open-mouth expressions verify robustness under extreme settings.

highlights.title: Follow the Policy, Fail the Benchmark: Auditing and Revising Policy-Based Decision Benchmarks
highlights.why: Systematic audit of nine policy benchmarks reveals widespread reference and evaluator errors that substantially inflate model scores.
highlights.key_result: Auditing policy-based decision benchmarks, the paper finds that responses supported by the supplied policy and case can be rejected, while incomplete decisions can be accepted; correcting the LegalBench SARA scorer raises acceptance by more than 80 percentage points for each of three models on 96 numeric cases, and restoring RuleArena Tax's required zero floor changes 27 of 300 references.

On the 96 LegalBench SARA numeric cases, correcting the scorer raises acceptance by more than 80 percentage points for each of three models, without changing references or responses.
In RuleArena Tax, restoring a required zero floor changes 27 of 300 references and narrows an observed model gap.

highlights.title: Expanding the Quality-Coverage Frontier with Competitive Flow Matching
highlights.authors: Wenxuan Peng, Richard Zhang, Haitian Zheng et al.
highlights.theme: Diffusion and flow matching generative models
highlights.why: Introduces competition among predictions to expand quality-coverage frontier in flow matching, addressing a core tradeoff.
highlights.key_result: The paper introduces Competitive Flow Matching (winner-take-all post-training with a low-dimensional auxiliary code) and shows it substantially improves the quality--coverage frontier: given less than 3% of the original SiT pretraining compute for post-training, at the 67% Recall point it reduces FD_r,6 from 19.22 to 5.91, and on RAEv2 at the 70% Recall point it reduces FD_r,6 from 16.83 to 3.18.
evidence: Together, these two guidance mechanisms show that our method substantially improves the quality--coverage frontier. We validate on ImageNet-256, using two different testbeds, SiT and RAEv2. Given less than 3% of the original SiT pretraining compute for post-training, at the 67% Recall point, our method reduces FD_r,6 from 19.22 to 5.91. On RAEv2, at the 70% Recall point, it reduces FD_r,6 from 16.83 to 3.18.

highlights.title: More Agents, More Reliable? System-Level Reliability of Multi-Agent LLMs under Operational-Profile Uncertainty
highlights.authors: Burkay Tuncturk, Koorosh Aslansefat, Yiannis Papadopoulos et al.
highlights.theme: LLM agent safety and multi-agent reliability
highlights.why: Provides rigorous system-level reliability analysis challenging the assumption that more agents are better under operational uncertainty.
highlights.key_result: In the hazard-extraction pipeline, majority voting over three models protected against the weakest but did not clearly exceed the best, and a voter failing on 5% of demands would largely erase its advantage over the middle model.
evidence: In a pipeline extracting regulated chemical-hazard statements, majority voting over three models protected against the weakest but did not clearly exceed the best, and a voter failing on 5% of demands would largely erase its advantage over the middle model.

With one hazard-extraction agent made redundant by TMR, an envelope built from the three replicas' separate evidence agreed in order of magnitude with one fitted to the voted outcomes, and the decomposition showed that voting guarded against the weakest replica but did not clearly exceed the best one.

At _V = 0.05 the lower bound of the redundant configuration reaches that of the middle agent, so beyond this point the voter, not the agents, drives the risk at the lower end of the envelope, and redundancy no longer improves even on the middle agent.

news.title: Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
news.summary: Cult.fit standardized engineering on Codex and extended it beyond engineering, with non-engineering teams building more than 20 internal applications in recent months and rebuilding an internal capability with Codex for $100,000+ in annual software savings. The company reports a 50%+ reduction in customer support costs and built a social feed end to end in two months, a project estimated to have previously taken more than a year.

news.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
news.summary: OpenAI reports collaborations with Australian universities including UNSW Sydney, University of Sydney, La Trobe University and Adelaide University, with UNSW bringing ChatGPT Edu to more than 80,000 students and staff. In a survey of more than 1,000 Australian university students, 81% said they use AI several times a week, 33% multiple times a day, 28% had built an AI agent or assistant, and 79% wanted more opportunities to use advanced AI tools on real-world projects.

news.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
news.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity model that scores 48.5% on ExploitGym versus 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber and avoided exploiting out-of-scope services in 99.93% of tests without its deployment prompt and 100% with the prompt. Researchers used it to develop 948 privilege escalation exploits in Linux and identify 81 previously unknown high-severity vulnerabilities in Firefox; OpenAI classifies the model as Critical in cybersecurity under its Preparedness Framework.

news.title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
news.summary: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT and Codex for product reviews, marketing and business development planning, and reports that tool calls through Merge succeed 99.9% of the time compared with around 60% for public MCP servers. For executive dinners, preparing guest lists and outreach and maintaining the attendee tracker went from dozens of hours across the company to about 30 minutes per event, and Merge ran 16 executive dinners in Q3, up from eight.

news.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
news.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with native 15-second video generation, up from 10 seconds in Omni 1.1, duration specified in one-second increments from 3 to 15 seconds, improved reference adherence and multi-turn conversational editing. The price dropped 30% from Gemini Omni 1.1 to $0.07 per second for 720p video, and the model is generally available on the Gemini API and Gemini for business.

news.title: Detecting signs of hypertension using wearable sensors
news.summary: Google Research presented AI-PPG-ACC-HTN, a multimodal AI system that uses smartwatch photoplethysmography and accelerometry to passively detect signs of hypertension without cuff calibration, validated against 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring. The waveform encoder was trained with self-supervised contrastive learning on 492,347 hours of sensor data from 2,109 consenting participants.

news.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
news.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with native 15-second video generation, up from 10 seconds in Omni 1.1, duration specified in one-second increments from 3 to 15 seconds, improved reference adherence and multi-turn conversational editing. The price dropped 30% from Gemini Omni 1.1 to $0.07 per second for 720p video, and the model is generally available on the Gemini API and Gemini for business.

news.title: Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit
news.summary: Microsoft Research introduced PDD Kit, a toolkit that turns a developer’s intent into a formal specification in Verus, proves agent-written code meets that specification for every input, and falls back to tests where a proof cannot reach. In a full-stack web app test, PDD Kit was used to formally verify the login logic of Pet Store, a Rust storefront, with the developer reviewing the intent and not reading the generated code line by line.

news.title: Vera Delivers the Best of Both Worlds: Highest Throughput and Fastest Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA announced performance results for its Vera CPU, reporting that in a 100-megawatt data center comparison a single Vera CPU outperforms both the fastest x86 CPU and the most energy-efficient x86 CPU, with 1.6x more agents per watt versus the fastest x86 CPU and 2x faster agent speed versus the most energy-efficient x86 CPU. Partners include Perplexity, which ran agentic coding tasks 1.5x faster with Vera, and DeepInfra, which reported up to 2.2x speed on agentic orchestration.

news.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA described developers directing frontier AI models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude through natural-language instructions, combined with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries, to build simulation applications. Examples include recreating an OP-1 portable synthesizer, testing robotic disassembly of a car suspension in Isaac Sim, and creating an editable building model from site scans.

news.title: The Wizard of Open Weights: Chris Alexiuk Makes AI Easy With Open Models
news.summary: NVIDIA profiles Chris Alexiuk, a senior product research engineer in deep learning who teaches developers to build with open large language models and calls himself “No. 1 Nemotron Fan” for NVIDIA’s Nemotron family of open source, multimodal models. The article describes his use of YouTube and X to teach building, fine-tuning, evaluating and shipping LLM applications and agents.

news.title: More Performance From Every Byte: How Full-Stack Codesign Solves AI’s Memory Challenge
news.summary: NVIDIA described full-stack codesign for AI memory, reporting that from NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra to the Vera Rubin platform HBM capacity per GPU rose roughly 3% while agentic throughput per dollar rose by up to 30x on SemiAnalysis AgentX. The article cites agentic trajectories that in some cases process up to 3 million tokens and describes techniques including NVFP4 to reduce model weight storage.

news.title: Configure, Certify, and Operate Kubernetes GPU Clusters with NVIDIA DSX OS
news.summary: NVIDIA introduced NVIDIA DSX OS, an open source software layer in the DSX AI Factory Platform for configuring, certifying and operating Kubernetes GPU clusters, including NVIDIA AI Cluster Runtime, Cluster Readiness Engine and NVSentinel. All three projects are licensed under Apache 2.0.

news.title: Five Ways NVIDIA Co-Design Maximizes the Value of Every Byte in the AI Factory
news.summary: NVIDIA described five co-design techniques for maximizing the value of memory in AI factories, including NVFP4, which reduces model footprint by approximately 3.5x versus FP16 and 1.8x versus FP8. The company reports that Vera Rubin NVL72 delivers up to 30x the throughput per megawatt of GB300 NVL72 from the same 288 GB per GPU.

news.title: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
news.summary: NVIDIA added four new open-weight checkpoints to its Cosmos 3 world model family: Cosmos3-Nano-Transfer-Auto, Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto, Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Transfer and Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Bimanual. All four are post-trained examples of Cosmos 3 Nano with 16B trainable parameters and use the OpenMDW1.1 license, permitting commercial and non-commercial use under its terms.

news.title: Getting started with Web Answer on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
news.summary: AWS announced general availability of Web Answer on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, a managed AgentCore Gateway tool that takes a natural-language question and returns a synthesized answer in seconds grounded in current web sources, with each grounded claim mapped to a citation. The Gateway authenticates calls with AWS IAM or JWT and returns the answer and citations to the agent as a Model Context Protocol tool result.

news.title: How Amazon Marketplace evaluates content quality with Amazon SageMaker AI
news.summary: Amazon described using Vision-Language Models on Amazon SageMaker AI to evaluate A+ Content holistically, combining VLM semantic scores with OCR readability signals in a CatBoost classifier trained on expert annotations and using SHAP to explain quality decisions and generate improvement recommendations. The article states that selling partners using high-quality A+ Content boost sales by 8–20 percent compared with those without it.

highlights.authors: Ruitian Wang, Xinyu Yang, Minshen Zhang et al.
highlights.why: 声称以对数成本实现 million-token 外推，这可能是长上下文效率方面的潜在突破。
highlights.key_result: 从 Qwen3-4B 初始化，并在原始模型的 32K 训练长度上使用 0.62B 个 token 进行训练后，RecSA 在 RULER 上从 131K 到 2M 的每个长度上都优于所有基线；在 1M 时，它的得分为 60.5，而最佳基线 Dense + DCA 为 40.0。借助我们优化的内核，RecSA 从 64K 到 2M 的端到端预填充和解码速度都比稠密注意力更快；在一块 H200 GPU 上，在 524K 时，它使预填充加速 3.2 倍，解码加速 3.8 倍。
evidence: Initialized from Qwen3-4B and trained on 0.62B tokens at the original model's 32K training length, RecSA outperforms all baselines on RULER at every length from 131K to 2M; at 1M, it scores 60.5, compared with 40.0 for the best baseline, Dense + DCA.
With our optimized kernels, RecSA is faster than dense attention in end-to-end prefill and decoding from 64K to 2M; at 524K on one H200 GPU, it accelerates prefill by 3.2 and decoding by 3.8 .

highlights.title: The Memory Trap: Language Agents Overgeneralize from Benign Interactions
highlights.authors: Kaiqu Liang, Jaime Fernandez Fisac, Thomas L. Griffiths et al.
highlights.theme: LLM agent safety and multi-agent reliability
highlights.why: 证明了持续的良性记忆会导致 six 种前沿模型出现不安全且不可靠的行为，揭示了一种关键的智能体失效模式。
highlights.key_result: 我们表明，来自良性交互的记忆可能导致后续任务中的不安全或不可靠行为：在基线低于 0.01 的情况下，笔记将 Sonnet-4.6 上的不安全动作率提高到 0.66 至 0.81，将 Opus-4.7 上的提高到 0.35 至 0.58；以这种方式形成的笔记将 Opus-4.8 在 ImpossibleBench 上的作弊率从 29% 提高到 74%。
evidence: We show that memory from benign interactions can cause unsafe or unreliable behavior on later tasks.
From baselines below 0.01, notes raise the unsafe-action rate to 0.66 to 0.81 on Sonnet-4.6 and 0.35 to 0.58 on Opus-4.7.

On ImpossibleBench's SWE-bench conflicting split, whose tests conflict with the specification , stronger models can cheat more with memory: notes formed this way raise Opus-4.8's cheating rate from 29% to 74%, while Fable-5 is barely affected.

highlights.title: Towards Foundation Decision Models: Drex
highlights.authors: Nischay Dhankhar, Alisher Amantay, Zhanibek Datbayev et al.
highlights.why: 开放的决策模型系列，无需自回归解码即可返回选项上的分布，在 Decision Index 上创下新的 SOTA，并解决生产可靠性问题。
highlights.key_result: 在 Decision Index 0.4.1 上，Max 在我们比较的决策模型中创下了新的最优水平（公开套件上为 67.52，而 Jev 1.14.0 为 60.70）。Max 在 183 ms 内回答典型请求，而 GPT-6 Sol 约为 2.0 s，Claude Opus 5.5 为 3.5 s，并且在选项重排下表现出输出稳定性。
evidence: On Decision Index 0.4.1, Max sets a new state-of-the-art among the decision models we compare (67.52 on the public suite vs 60.70 for Jev 1.14.0).
Max answers a typical request in 183 ms, against about 2.0 s for GPT-6 Sol and 3.5 s for Claude Opus 5.5, and demonstrates output stability under option reordering.

highlights.title: EDGAR: Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement via Synthetic Failure
highlights.authors: Kwan Yun, Minhyeok Bang, Colette Suhjung Koo et al.
highlights.why: 通过合成失败对高斯化身进行基于扩散的优化，结合 MoE 和身份保持，直接解决常见伪影。
highlights.key_result: 对 three 种不同的高斯化身重建方法（每种方法在 three 种不同设置下评估）的实验表明，在感知和重建指标上均优于原始输出和 SDEdit 风格的优化基线。此外，跨视角评估证明了改进的校准一致性，而大偏航和张嘴表情下的测试验证了极端设置下的鲁棒性。
evidence: Experiments on three different Gaussian avatar reconstruction methods, each evaluated under three different settings, show improvements in both perceptual and reconstruction measures over the raw outputs and an SDEdit-style refinement baseline. In addition, cross-view evaluation demonstrates improved calibrated consistency, while tests under large yaw and open-mouth expressions verify robustness under extreme settings.

highlights.title: Follow the Policy, Fail the Benchmark: Auditing and Revising Policy-Based Decision Benchmarks
highlights.why: 对 nine 个策略基准的系统性审计揭示了广泛存在的参考和评估器错误，这些错误显著抬高了模型得分。
highlights.key_result: 通过审计基于策略的决策基准，本文发现由所提供的策略和案例支持的回答可能被拒绝，而不完整的决策可能被接受；纠正 LegalBench SARA 评分器使 96 个数值案例上的 three 个模型的每个接受率提高超过 80 percentage points，恢复 RuleArena Tax 所需的零下限改变了 300 个参考中的 27 个。
evidence: We audit nine public policy-based decision benchmarks and find that responses supported by the supplied policy and case can be rejected, while incomplete decisions can be accepted.
On the 96 LegalBench SARA numeric cases, correcting the scorer raises acceptance by more than 80 percentage points for each of three models, without changing references or responses.
In RuleArena Tax, restoring a required zero floor changes 27 of 300 references and narrows an observed model gap.

highlights.title: Expanding the Quality-Coverage Frontier with Competitive Flow Matching
highlights.authors: Wenxuan Peng, Richard Zhang, Haitian Zheng et al.
highlights.theme: Diffusion and flow matching generative models
highlights.why: 在 flow matching 中引入预测之间的竞争，以扩展质量-覆盖前沿，解决核心权衡。
highlights.key_result: 本文提出了 Competitive Flow Matching（使用低维辅助码的赢者通吃后训练），并表明它大幅改善了质量-覆盖前沿：在仅使用不到 3% 的原始 SiT 预训练计算进行后训练的情况下，在 67% Recall 点处，它将 FD_r,6 从 19.22 降低到 5.91；在 RAEv2 上，在 70% Recall 点处，它将 FD_r,6 从 16.83 降低到 3.18。
evidence: Together, these two guidance mechanisms show that our method substantially improves the quality--coverage frontier. We validate on ImageNet-256, using two different testbeds, SiT and RAEv2. Given less than 3% of the original SiT pretraining compute for post-training, at the 67% Recall point, our method reduces FD_r,6 from 19.22 to 5.91. On RAEv2, at the 70% Recall point, it reduces FD_r,6 from 16.83 to 3.18.

highlights.title: More Agents, More Reliable? System-Level Reliability of Multi-Agent LLMs under Operational-Profile Uncertainty
highlights.authors: Burkay Tuncturk, Koorosh Aslansefat, Yiannis Papadopoulos et al.
highlights.theme: LLM agent safety and multi-agent reliability
highlights.why: 提供了严格的系统级可靠性分析，挑战了在运行不确定性下更多智能体更好的假设。
highlights.key_result: 在危险提取流水线中，对 three 个模型进行多数投票可以抵御最弱的模型，但并未明显超过最好的模型；如果投票器在 5% 的需求上失败，其在中间模型上的优势将大部分消失。
evidence: In a pipeline extracting regulated chemical-hazard statements, majority voting over three models protected against the weakest but did not clearly exceed the best, and a voter failing on 5% of demands would largely erase its advantage over the middle model.

With one hazard-extraction agent made redundant by TMR, an envelope built from the three replicas' separate evidence agreed in order of magnitude with one fitted to the voted outcomes, and the decomposition showed that voting guarded against the weakest replica but did not clearly exceed the best one.

At _V = 0.05 the lower bound of the redundant configuration reaches that of the middle agent, so beyond this point the voter, not the agents, drives the risk at the lower end of the envelope, and redundancy no longer improves even on the middle agent.

news.title: Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
news.summary: Cult.fit 将工程标准化在 Codex 上，并将其扩展到工程之外，非工程团队在最近几个月构建了 20 多个内部应用，并用 Codex 重建了一项内部能力，每年节省超过 $100,000+ 的软件成本。该公司报告客户支持成本降低了 50%+，并在 two 个月内端到端构建了一个社交信息流，此前估计该项目需要超过一年。

news.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
news.summary: OpenAI 报告了与澳大利亚大学的合作，包括 UNSW Sydney、University of Sydney、La Trobe University 和 Adelaide University，其中 UNSW 将 ChatGPT Edu 带给超过 80,000 名学生和教职工。在对超过 1,000 名澳大利亚大学生的调查中，81% 表示每周多次使用 AI，33% 每天多次使用，28% 曾构建过 AI 智能体或助手，79% 希望有更多机会在真实项目中使用先进 AI 工具。

news.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
news.summary: OpenAI 推出了 GPT-6 Cyber，这是一个网络安全模型，在 ExploitGym 上得分为 48.5%，而 GPT-5.6 Cyber 为 32.1%，在没有部署提示的测试中，99.93% 的情况下避免利用范围外服务，在有提示时为 100%。研究人员使用它开发了 948 个 Linux 特权提升漏洞利用，并识别出 Firefox 中 81 个此前未知的高严重性漏洞；OpenAI 根据其 Preparedness Framework 将该模型归类为网络安全领域 Critical。

news.title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
news.summary: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT and Codex for product reviews, marketing and business development planning, and reports that tool calls through Merge succeed 99.9% of the time compared with around 60% for public MCP servers. For executive dinners, preparing guest lists and outreach and maintaining the attendee tracker went from dozens of hours across the company to about 30 minutes per event, and Merge ran 16 executive dinners in Q3, up from eight.

news.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
news.summary: Google DeepMind 发布了 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，具有原生 15-second 视频生成能力，高于 Omni 1.1 的 10 seconds，时长以 one-second 为增量，从 3 到 15 seconds，并改进了参考一致性和多轮对话编辑。价格从 Gemini Omni 1.1 下降了 30%，降至 720p 视频每 second $0.07，该模型已在 Gemini API 和 Gemini for business 上正式可用。

news.title: Detecting signs of hypertension using wearable sensors
news.summary: Google Research 展示了 AI-PPG-ACC-HTN，这是一个多模态 AI 系统，使用智能手表的光电容积脉搏波和加速度计，无需袖带校准即可被动检测高血压迹象，并针对 24-hour 动态血压监测进行了验证。波形编码器使用自监督对比学习在来自 2,109 名知情同意参与者的 492,347 hours 传感器数据上进行训练。

news.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
news.summary: Google DeepMind 发布了 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，具有原生 15-second 视频生成能力，高于 Omni 1.1 的 10 seconds，时长以 one-second 为增量，从 3 到 15 seconds，并改进了参考一致性和多轮对话编辑。价格从 Gemini Omni 1.1 下降了 30%，降至 720p 视频每 second $0.07，该模型已在 Gemini API 和 Gemini for business 上正式可用。

news.title: Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit
news.summary: Microsoft Research 推出了 PDD Kit，这是一个工具包，可将开发者的意图转换为 Verus 中的形式化规范，证明智能体编写的代码对每个输入都满足该规范，并在无法证明时退回到测试。在一个全栈 Web 应用测试中，PDD Kit 被用于形式化验证 Pet Store（一个 Rust 店面）的登录逻辑，开发者审查意图而无需逐行阅读生成的代码。

news.title: Vera Delivers the Best of Both Worlds: Highest Throughput and Fastest Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA 公布了其 Vera CPU 的性能结果，报告称在 100-megawatt 数据中心对比中，单个 Vera CPU 的性能同时优于最快的 x86 CPU 和最节能的 x86 CPU，相比最快的 x86 CPU，每 watt 智能体数量多 1.6x，相比最节能的 x86 CPU，智能体速度快 2x。合作伙伴包括 Perplexity，其使用 Vera 运行智能体编码任务快了 1.5x，以及 DeepInfra，其报告智能体编排速度最高提升 2.2x。

news.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA 描述了开发者通过自然语言指令指挥 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude 等前沿 AI 模型，结合 NVIDIA Omniverse 库来构建仿真应用。示例包括重现 OP-1 便携合成器、在 Isaac Sim 中测试机器人拆卸汽车悬架，以及从现场扫描创建可编辑的建筑模型。

news.title: The Wizard of Open Weights: Chris Alexiuk Makes AI Easy With Open Models
news.summary: NVIDIA 介绍了 Chris Alexiuk，他是一位深度学习高级产品研究工程师，教授开发者使用开放式大型语言模型进行构建，并称自己为 NVIDIA 开源多模态 Nemotron 系列的“No. 1 Nemotron Fan”。文章描述了他利用 YouTube 和 X 教授构建、微调、评估和发布 LLM 应用与智能体。

news.title: More Performance From Every Byte: How Full-Stack Codesign Solves AI’s Memory Challenge
news.summary: NVIDIA 描述了 AI 内存的全栈协同设计，报告称从 NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra 到 Vera Rubin 平台，每个 GPU 的 HBM 容量大约增加了 3%，而在 SemiAnalysis AgentX 上，每 dollar 智能体吞吐量最高提高了 30x。文章引用了在某些情况下处理多达 3 million 个 token 的智能体轨迹，并介绍了包括 NVFP4 在内的技术以减少模型权重存储。

news.title: Configure, Certify, and Operate Kubernetes GPU Clusters with NVIDIA DSX OS
news.summary: NVIDIA 推出了 NVIDIA DSX OS，这是 DSX AI Factory Platform 中的一个开源软件层，用于配置、认证和运行 Kubernetes GPU 集群，包括 NVIDIA AI Cluster Runtime、Cluster Readiness Engine 和 NVSentinel。所有 three 个项目均采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。

news.title: Five Ways NVIDIA Co-Design Maximizes the Value of Every Byte in the AI Factory
news.summary: NVIDIA 描述了 five 种协同设计技术，以最大化 AI 工厂中内存的价值，其中包括 NVFP4，它相对于 FP16 将模型占用空间减少约 3.5x，相对于 FP8 减少约 1.8x。该公司报告称，Vera Rubin NVL72 在相同的每个 GPU 288 GB 下，每 megawatt 吞吐量最高可达 GB300 NVL72 的 30x。

news.title: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
news.summary: NVIDIA 在其 Cosmos 3 世界模型系列中新增了 four 个开放权重检查点：Cosmos3-Nano-Transfer-Auto、Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto、Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Transfer 和 Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Bimanual。所有 four 个都是 Cosmos 3 Nano 的后训练示例，具有 16B 可训练参数，并使用 OpenMDW1.1 许可证，允许根据其条款进行商业和非商业使用。

news.title: Getting started with Web Answer on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
news.summary: AWS 宣布 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 上的 Web Answer 正式可用，这是一个托管 AgentCore Gateway 工具，接受自然语言问题并在几秒钟内返回基于当前网络来源的综合答案，每个有依据的声明都映射到一个引用。该 Gateway 使用 AWS IAM 或 JWT 对调用进行身份验证，并将答案和引用作为 Model Context Protocol 工具结果返回给智能体。

news.title: How Amazon Marketplace evaluates content quality with Amazon SageMaker AI
news.summary: Amazon 描述了在 Amazon SageMaker AI 上使用 Vision-Language Models 来整体评估 A+ Content，将 VLM 语义得分与 OCR 可读性信号结合在基于专家标注训练的 CatBoost 分类器中，并使用 SHAP 解释质量决策并生成改进建议。文章指出，使用高质量 A+ Content 的销售伙伴相比未使用的销售伙伴销售额提升了 8–20 percent。
